title: Session record: the DEC-46..52 build, DEC-56, and the recycle
description: Session record for the recycle at the close of the DEC wave, landed on dev because a handoff that only exists in a working tree is one a successor cannot read. The durable half is this record; .claude/handovers/cursor.md is gitignored and stays local.
implementationNotes:
HANDOFF, 2026-09-29, session recycled on context budget at the orchestrator request, after the DEC wave closed. This is the session record; the cursor is local, gitignored and not authoritative.

LANDED, all through gated pull requests (required checks green on each deliverable commit and again on each merge head): opum-ai/ward-cli#126 promoted dev to main at e857e5c; #127 WCLI-46 clean:temp (DEC-49, ADR 0013); #128 WCLI-14 skill-file drift plus the init multiselect (DEC-46/47/48/52, ADRs 0014-0017, @clack/prompts pinned 1.8.0); #129 WCLI-38 profileSnapshotVersion at first release (DEC-50, ADR 0018, plus the new release runbook); #130 WCLI-30 spec pointer concept (DEC-51, ADR 0019); #131 promoted dev to main at e7bec34; #132 WCLI-61 recorded DEC-56, the pointer keeps its two sections. WCLI-14, WCLI-30, WCLI-38, WCLI-46 and WCLI-61 are all closed.

LIVE STATE at handoff: origin/dev == local dev == c0f48a1; origin/main == e7bec34; dev is +1 and NOT promoted, by the orchestrator instruction that this record rides the next batch. No open pull requests, tree clean, nothing else In Progress.

WHAT THE SUCCESSOR SHOULD KNOW, each with where it lives:
- The +1 commit (this record) rides the next promotion. Promotion is an orchestrator call; the shape is a PR from dev, wait-for check-runs --base dev on the exact SHA, a bare git push origin origin/dev:main, then the tree-equality and ancestry assertions, and report origin/main by ref.
- WCLI-14 closed with T25 unchecked and recorded (unresolvedAtCompletion): the federated index cannot validate and resolve to an artifact that does not exist; spec section 11.3 schedules the public marketplace entry for the later phase and the private-marketplace half is filed in opum-fleet. quest task list --unresolved-at-completion finds it.
- Release-time obligations are gathered in docs/runbooks/cutting-a-ward-release.md: step 1 is the profileSnapshotVersion bump (DEC-50, ADR 0018), then the plugin and CLI version agreement, the T24 manual smoke, and the marketplace condition. WCLI-15 carries a pointer note.
- This machine TMPDIR still holds the ward-* residue: one deliberate bun run clean:temp reclaims it (dry run measured 869 roots, 724 older than 120 minutes, about 19 GiB). Deliberately NOT run: destructive cleanup of a shared TMPDIR is a person call.

METHOD NOTES, verified this session: (1) Adding bundle concepts means re-measuring and usually raising profile max_tokens - check-lore-agent-sources fails on any truncation, and ADR 0008 explains why a tight budget is itself the defect. (2) A lore concept summary over about 200 characters only warns at creation but fails lore validate --strict, which is the Docs job first step. (3) Never compose rm -rf with another command or a command substitution - the guard refuses it; read the path in its own call and remove by literal path in its own call. (4) The promotion PR shows no checks of its own by design (WCLI-57); the evidence is the dev push run at the same SHA.

Skills for the successor: opum-sdlc (task before branch, the promotion shape), quest, lore, opum-handoff restore.
